title: Ahaziah and Athaliah

questions.question: Who did the inhabitants of Jerusalem make king in Jehoram's place?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:1 (ESV): "And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, his youngest son, king in his place..."

questions.question: Who was Ahaziah's counselor to do wickedly?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:3 (ESV): "...for his mother was his counselor in doing wickedly."

questions.question: Who executed judgment on the house of Ahab?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:7 (ESV): "...Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to destroy the house of Ahab."

questions.question: Where was Ahaziah hiding when Jehu sought him?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:9 (ESV): "And he searched for Ahaziah, who was captured while hiding in Samaria..."

questions.question: What did Athaliah do when she saw her son was dead?
options: She arose and destroyed all the royal family of the house of Judah
questions.correctAnswer: She arose and destroyed all the royal family of the house of Judah
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:10 (ESV): "...she arose and destroyed all the royal family of the house of Judah."

questions.question: Who was saved from Athaliah's purge?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:11 (ESV): "But Jehoshabeath... took Joash the son of Ahaziah and stole him away..."

questions.question: Who hid Joash?
options: Jehoshabeath (Jehosheba), the daughter of the king
questions.correctAnswer: Jehoshabeath (Jehosheba), the daughter of the king
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:11 (ESV): "But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash..."

questions.question: Where was Joash hidden?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:12 (ESV): "And he remained with them six years, hidden in the house of God..."

questions.question: How long did Athaliah reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:12 (ESV): "...while Athaliah reigned over the land."

questions.question: Who was Jehoshabeath's husband?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:11 (ESV): "...(now she was the wife of Jehoiada the priest...)"

questions.question: How old was Ahaziah when he began to reign?
options: 42 (or 22 depending on translation/manuscript tradition - ESV says 42 here)
questions.correctAnswer: 42 (or 22 depending on translation/manuscript tradition - ESV says 42 here)
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:2 (ESV): "Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he began to reign..." (Note: 2 Kings 8:26 says 22. This is a known copyist discussion point, but ESV text says 42).

questions.question: Who helped Ahaziah in his war against Hazael?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:5 (ESV): "He went with Jehoram the son of Ahab... to make war against Hazael..."

questions.question: Where was Jehoram wounded?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:6 (ESV): "And he returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds that he had received at Ramah..."

questions.question: Why was Ahaziah killed by Jehu?
options: It was ordained by God that the downfall of Ahaziah should come about through his going to visit Joram
questions.correctAnswer: It was ordained by God that the downfall of Ahaziah should come about through his going to visit Joram
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:7 (ESV): "But it was ordained by God that the downfall of Ahaziah should come about through his going to visit Joram."

questions.question: Why did they bury Ahaziah?
options: Because he is the grandson of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart
questions.correctAnswer: Because he is the grandson of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 22:9 (ESV): "...For they said, 'He is the grandson of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart.'"

key_verse_text: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother was his counselor in doing wickedly.
